phase_a_orientation.summary: OrderService.createOrder(Order) is annotated @Transactional, calls OrderRepository.save(order), then immediately invokes EventPublisher.publish with the string "ORDER_CREATED:" plus order.getId(). EventPublisher and OrderRepository are simple interfaces; there is no visible post-commit hook or deferred/outbox mechanism, so event emission currently occurs synchronously inside the creation method after save and before the transactional method returns.
